$comment: Report configuration. Unbranded by default: nothing here names an employer, and the reports carry no logo. `tax_name` and `currency` are the two fields that make this work outside one jurisdiction. `classification` is optional; omit it and both reports drop the column and the basis table with no other change.

classification.name: R&D
classification.caveat: There is no vendor whitelist: every TRUE is a default position on the face of the expense, and each still has to be apportioned against the company's own share before it becomes a deduction.

closing_notes: Notional deductions are stated excluding tax, so the ex-tax column is the one to work from.
